lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately 15-20 distinct high-luminance circular blobs are visible across the mid-lateral flank, arranged in three primary horizontal rows with increasing spatial dispersion toward the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, forming a loose grid pattern where they intersect with the primary horizontal rows of circular blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature with a high-contrast luminance gradient (light superior, shadowed inferior) runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) attached to the lateral flank and near the base of the visible pectoral fin.
